behavior_before: Living Diagnostics provided provenance, checkpoint applicability, Cookbook knowledge, and candidate query, but no normalized structural comprehension model or bounded subsystem packet.
behavior_after: The existing diagnostics owner can build a revision-grounded component/workflow/checkpoint/failure-seam model, render deterministic Mermaid views, classify source staleness, and export provider-neutral bounded packets.
new_failure_modes: authored comprehension model references missing source
preliminary_troubleshooting_notes: Treat inferred relationships and candidate seams as non-canonical.
When source hashes change, revalidate affected understanding before relying on it.
prohibited_recovery_actions: Do not create a second registry or scheduler.
Do not let a provider mutate the canonical model or authorize remediation.
activation_restart_impact: No runtime restart. The model and views are deterministic repository artifacts; the existing scheduler remains the reconciliation owner.
